traits.name: Alter Weather
traits.text: ⬽ Frequency three times per day Effect The veranallia dramatically alters weather patterns in the surrounding area, producing any of the results of a successful 9th-level control weather ritual.

traits.name: Rebirth
traits.text: (divine, necromancy); Frequency once per day Effect The veranallia spends a minute to encase a creature that has been dead for no more than a year in a cocoon. After 24 hours, the creature is restored to life, and the cocoon explodes in a shower of colorful blossoms. If the veranallia's chooses, Rebirth can change the creature's ancestry or heritage, typically into an aasimar.
